QuestInfo.name: [Repeatable] Technologically Enhanced Breadcrumbs
QuestInfo.0: Get back into the alien base and sabotage their work.
QuestInfo.1: Put up a flag in the base to help other adventurers infiltrate the base.
QuestInfo.2: Flag placed! This base is going to be swarming with Maple warriors soon!

0.0: I've got a little game-plan to mess up their operations. I call it 'Operation Post a Flag on the Place and then Aliens Suffer'! It's a working title. Are you up for some subterfuge?!
0.1: Think you can handle it? Are you ready to mess up some aliens?

yes.1: Get into that alien base and look for the spot. You'll know where to put the flag when you see it.

no.0: Not into the whole spy thing, huh? Well, maybe you'll care about the future of this city later.

yes.0: The flag is in place! Operation Flags of Our Maplers is on track! We've got more adventurers moving in after you, but you're going to keep that flag up if the aliens find it!
